IAM-01

Agent identity per agent

Give every agent its own identity. Never let an agent use a shared or a human account.

  • Identity and access
  • preventive
  • Identity and delegation
  • Required from L1
  • Agents, Voice, IoT, Physical AI
How it works
Issue a workload identity for each agent version. Bind short-lived tokens to that identity.
Evidence an auditor asks for
Identity register. Token issue logs. Review that finds no shared credentials.
Layers aligned
Application, Technical: Backend
  • NIST AI RMF Govern, Manage
  • OWASP LLM 2025 LLM06 Excessive agency
  • SOX/COSO ITGC Access
  • ISO/IEC 42001 AI management system
IAM-02

On-behalf-of delegation

Each agent acts for a named, accountable person, inside a delegation with a scope and an expiry date.

  • Identity and access
  • preventive
  • Identity and delegation
  • Required from L2
  • Agents, Voice, IoT, Physical AI
How it works
The delegation token carries owner, scope and expiry. The gateway rejects calls without it.
Evidence an auditor asks for
Delegation record per agent. Owner sign-off. Expiry report.
Layers aligned
Application, Technical: Backend, Technical: Frontend
  • NIST AI RMF Govern
  • SOX/COSO ITGC Access
  • ISO/IEC 42001 AI management system

SOD-01

Approver cannot change limits

The person who approves agent actions may not change the limits, instructions or tools of that agent.

  • preventive
  • Policy and limits
  • Required from L2
  • Agents, Voice, IoT, Physical AI
How it works
The policy engine holds role-conflict rules. A different owner must approve each change request.
Evidence an auditor asks for
Role-conflict report. Change tickets that show a separate approver.
